about_the_game:
Frutiger Space is currently under development, and much of what you see is still a work in progress. If something appears incomplete or wonky, don't worry, it's either being updated or will be fixed in future updates!

An Overview

Frutiger Space is a social multiplayer game set in a utopian and futuristic universe, like the aesthetic of the internet's heyday. Whether you're exploring, playing minigames, accessorizing your Meeple, getting in on some secrets, or just rocking out to music bobbing in a bubble, there's always something to do!

Chat with Friends

The game captures the essence of retro internet social games, giving you a place to chat with old friends and even make new ones! Be part of a friendly and welcoming community.

A World of Frutiger Subgenres

Each of the islands has its own style, influenced by various Frutiger Aero subgenres, such as Frutiger Eco, Frutiger Aqua, Frutiger Metro, Technozen and more!

Meeple Customization

Your Meeple can be personalised with a huge selection of cosmetics. Express your personality with unique outfits, stylish hats, and accessories. You can purchase new things with Frutiger Orbs, which are obtained by playing minigames, completing tasks, or simply exploring the world to discover its riches.

Activities and Minigames

Frutiger Space also features a collection of minigames and activities to have fun with!
Of course, no grinding and sweating. The main ones include:

  • Dolphin Racing

  • Watergun Battles

  • Fruit Collecting

  • And much more to come!
